places.quote: he was then at the Gray's Inn Coffee-house to lay his professional evidence before a Commission of Lunacy
places.note: Mr. Chillip is there at the time of the conversation; location of the talk is implied.

places.quote: passed the next day on the Dover coach; burst safe and sound into my aunt's old parlour
places.note: Dover is named only as the coach destination, but the aunt's home there is the setting of the closing action.
